design_note: Global Zoo Curator geography registry with parallel nested map hierarchies. Land/freshwater: One Earth realm-division -> subrealm -> bioregion. Coastal/shelf ocean: MEOW realm -> province -> ecoregion. Off-shelf surface ocean/high seas: PPOW realm -> province. UI should use each framework's broad recognizable parent as the overview layer and reveal its child units on zoom. MEOW and PPOW are broadly aligned and non-overlapping. Deep benthic geography remains reserved.

ui_hierarchy.note: PPOW biomes are ecological classes, not geographic parent regions.

deep_benthic.note: Reserved for a future deep-benthic framework (e.g. GOODS/Watling-derived bathyal and abyssal provinces). Do not infer deep-benthic distribution from PPOW.

geography_field_policy.wild_regions: One Earth bioregion IDs for terrestrial and freshwater occurrence; coastal terrestrial use remains valid.
geography_field_policy.marine_regions: MEOW ecoregion IDs for coastal/shelf marine occurrence.
geography_field_policy.pelagic_regions: PPOW province IDs for off-shelf surface-pelagic occurrence, including high seas.
geography_field_policy.habitat_tags: Ecology only (e.g. coastal, mangrove, wetland); never substitute habitat tags for geographic units.
geography_field_policy.overlap_rule: For marine animals, prefer MEOW inside coastal/shelf waters and PPOW off-shelf. Amphibious/coastal-breeding species may also retain One Earth land regions for genuine terrestrial life-history use.

map_ui_policy.overview: Show the broadest parent region at world/continental zoom.
map_ui_policy.zoom: Reveal child regions progressively; a fully covered parent must still expand into children when zoomed.
map_ui_policy.collapse: A parent may visually collapse when all of its children are covered.
map_ui_policy.hover: Show only the currently visible geographic unit name.
map_ui_policy.storage: Store animal occurrence at each framework's factual detail level; derive parents from the hierarchy.
map_ui_policy.marine_split: Use MEOW for coastal/shelf waters and PPOW for off-shelf surface-pelagic waters.

schema_compatibility.notes: Existing realms/subrealms/bioregions and MEOW/PPOW IDs are preserved. v8.1 centralizes UI rules and adds generic field routing.
